text:
我现在同时用 6 套 AI 额度，每月现金只花 $283 左右。很多人问额度怎么来的，一次说清：

1. Claude Max 20x，$250/月
App Store 订阅（官网是 $200，App Store 贵一点）。额度分两层：5 小时窗口 + 每周上限，没有固定 token 数。我 4 月实测过一个月，按 API 价折算用掉了 $3,000 多。现在它只干最值钱的活：拍板、写代码、验收。

2. X Premium+，年付 €377，合 $33/月
附带 Grok，每周一个额度池。它还能用来开 Grok Bot，见第 4 条。

3. Cursor，$0
我是 Cursor Friend，每月送 Ultra。Grok 4.7 和 Composer 共用每周额度。注意：在 Cursor 里调 Claude、GPT 不走这个额度，按 API 价另扣。
X 10 月出了合并订阅。之前经过 AI 建议，不要把 Cursor Ultra 和已有的 X Premium+ 合并。果然刷到有人合并后失去了 Friends 资格，血亏。还好听了 AI 的建议先评估了一下，AI 省钱经历 +1。

4. Grok Bot 两套，$0
第一套通过 Cursor Ultra 开通。第二套是在另一台设备上，用新的 Cursor 身份选「Get access with Grok」，走 X Premium+ 入口，开出了一套独立的（8 月写过过程）。两套各有每周额度，互不影响。

5. ChatGPT / Codex，$0
Pro 10 月中到期，我没续。但 9 月底官方送了 62,500 点，Codex 能用，12 月 31 日过期。我实测大约 4.3 万 token 扣 1 点。

几个不浪费的经验：
· 先查清每套额度按周、按月还是按点数算。按周的不用就作废，优先用
· 送的、附带的先用，自己掏钱的留给最难的活
· 赠送点数一定看到期日。我这 5 万多点，照现在的用法到年底会作废一大半，接下来得专门往 Codex 派活

text:
Claude API 单次请求上限从 32 MB 提到 128 MB，长时间截图任务和大 PDF 不容易再卡住，只限 Anthropic 官方 API

Anthropic 把 Claude API 单次请求能发送的数据量上限，从 32 MB 提高到 128 MB，大约是原来的 4 倍。调整的是 Messages（调用模型的主接口）和 Token Counting（发送前估算 token 用量的接口）。这次改的是开发者调用的接口，在 Claude App 里聊天不在公告范围内。

【为什么要提】

以前开发者经常碰到的情况是：请求已经超过 32 MB 被拒，模型的上下文窗口（一次能读进去的内容总量）却还剩很多。

原因是图片和 PDF 的文件大小和 token 用量（token 是 AI 计算用量的单位）对不上。图片要编码成文本整个放进请求里，一张高清截图可能就占一两 MB，可在模型那里，一张图最多只算几千个 token。让 Claude 操作电脑的 computer use 任务，每走一步都要截一次屏，跑久了，几十张截图就能把 32 MB 用完，上下文窗口才用掉一小部分。一次传一份很大的 PDF，也是同样的情况。

现在空间多了大约 4 倍，这类任务在一次请求里能走得更远。

【多图请求的单图上限也放宽了】

一次请求超过 20 张图时，以前每张图的长和宽都不能超过 2000 像素，现在放宽到 3000 像素。20 张以内的请求不受这条限制，单张图最大仍是 8000×8000 像素。

按官方文档，Claude 4.7 及之后的模型最多能看清长边 2576 像素的图。以前多图请求被限制在 2000 像素，用不满这个精度，现在 3000 像素的上限够用了。

【谁能用到】

128 MB 只适用于 Anthropic 自家的 Claude API。文档里已经直接写成 128 MB，没有提到需要申请或额外开启。官方也没提价格变化，费用照旧按实际用掉的 token 算。

通过云平台调用 Claude 的，不在这次调整范围内：亚马逊 Bedrock 是 20 MB，Google Cloud 上由 Google 托管的 Claude 是 30 MB，Claude Platform on AWS、Google Cloud 上由 Anthropic 托管的版本，以及微软 Microsoft Foundry，是 32 MB。

Anthropic 其他接口的上限各不相同：批量处理接口 Message Batches 是 256 MB，Files API（先上传文件，再在请求里引用）是 500 MB，托管智能体用的 Sessions、Agents、Environments 接口是 32 MB。超过上限会收到 413 错误。

文档：https://t.co/q9nt2wgvOi

result.text:
Claude API 单次请求上限从 32 MB 提到 128 MB，长时间截图任务和大 PDF 不容易再卡住，只限 Anthropic 官方 API

Anthropic 把 Claude API 单次请求能发送的数据量上限，从 32 MB 提高到 128 MB，大约是原来的 4 倍。调整的是 Messages（调用模型的主接口）和 Token Counting（发送前估算 token 用量的接口）。这次改的是开发者调用的接口，在 Claude App 里聊天不在公告范围内。

【为什么要提】

以前开发者经常碰到的情况是：请求已经超过 32 MB 被拒，模型的上下文窗口（一次能读进去的内容总量）却还剩很多。

原因是图片和 PDF 的文件大小和 token 用量（token 是 AI 计算用量的单位）对不上。图片要编码成文本整个放进请求里，一张高清截图可能就占一两 MB，可在模型那里，一张图最多只算几千个 token。让 Claude 操作电脑的 computer use 任务，每走一步都要截一次屏，跑久了，几十张截图就能把 32 MB 用完，上下文窗口才用掉一小部分。一次传一份很大的 PDF，也是同样的情况。

现在空间多了大约 4 倍，这类任务在一次请求里能走得更远。

【多图请求的单图上限也放宽了】

一次请求超过 20 张图时，以前每张图的长和宽都不能超过 2000 像素，现在放宽到 3000 像素。20 张以内的请求不受这条限制，单张图最大仍是 8000×8000 像素。

按官方文档，Claude 4.7 及之后的模型最多能看清长边 2576 像素的图。以前多图请求被限制在 2000 像素，用不满这个精度，现在 3000 像素的上限够用了。

【谁能用到】

128 MB 只适用于 Anthropic 自家的 Claude API。文档里已经直接写成 128 MB，没有提到需要申请或额外开启。官方也没提价格变化，费用照旧按实际用掉的 token 算。

通过云平台调用 Claude 的，不在这次调整范围内：亚马逊 Bedrock 是 20 MB，Google Cloud 上由 Google 托管的 Claude 是 30 MB，Claude Platform on AWS、Google Cloud 上由 Anthropic 托管的版本，以及微软 Microsoft Foundry，是 32 MB。

Anthropic 其他接口的上限各不相同：批量处理接口 Message Batches 是 256 MB，Files API（先上传文件，再在请求里引用）是 500 MB，托管智能体用的 Sessions、Agents、Environments 接口是 32 MB。超过上限会收到 413 错误。

文档：https://t.co/q9nt2wgvOi

My theory on why OpenAI suddenly doubled Pro limits, when it's been short on capacity for weeks.

Right now chat, Codex and Dots each have their own allowance. But OpenAI already merged Chat and Work into one app, and Dots is only free on its own allowance "for now". If all three end up drawing from the same pool later, doubling it today might just be making room for everything that's about to land in it.

So it could be a real upgrade if you mostly use Codex, or just a bigger bucket for three things at once.

Either way, Plus still got nothing. Not even the 5 hour limit removed.

text:
Introducing *Switch*: a *harness framework* for *decision models* like Jev

I looked for this the other day and was surprised to not find anything like it

You obviously cannot use a decision model like an LLM in a coding agent harness like @pidotdev, because Jev cannot generate tool calls

But what if there was a framework that "generated the tool calls" for it programmatically, and Jev only had to pick out of that finite set of choices

That is what switch does. You pick a "domain" to implement the decision model in, and it provides a core API to define your state, and the functions that will derive decision model questions out of that state. Chess is a domain, as well as being a rubric judge for evals

It basically standardizes what I imagine a lot of people are already vibe-coding, to an abstract interface: calling a decision-model API through multiple steps, i.e. an agent loop over finite choices

Because of the finiteness of the output of a decision model, you cannot have a general pure decision model harness. Instead, you need to implement specific ones that generate the choices programmatically (or have an LLM generate the choices, but I find the former more interesting) 

A primary use case I have for this is use as a judge in an eval. For example, At the end of a task run that involves a bunch of documents, most people currently follow this approach: extract text out of PDF/docx/md files, and dump them right into the context

But what if the visual formatting of the output is a judging criterion? Then you have to dump an image of every page in the input state. But what if you have 200 pages, and your question does not need looking at all of them? What if Jev could navigate through the haystack and find the info it needs?

I have noticed that Jev is not so good at chess nor being a Decision-Model-as-a-Judge. It sucks at chess, and it does not perform well enough to replace GPT 6.1 Sol as a judge in the domain I am working for

But switch is not only for Jev! It is for any decision model including the ones supported by the pi-ai package

So once you can generate enough data with a better model, you should be able to pick an open source one and fine-tune it on your use case to perform better! And the model should be trained in a harness like switch's to be especially performant and cost-efficient

I wanted to get this out because I find the idea very exciting, at least for benchmarking. Jev is currently not there, but decision models obviously will be there at some point, and we can take them there! There are also a lot of potential gains from picking a specific domain, and creating a looping agent that does a job for 100x cheaper!

Let me know if you have any ideas, I am quite keen to try this on new domains!

小学的时候上课喜欢翘二郎腿，有次不小心把 鸡鸡 放在两腿之间。也不知道怎么回事，像是命运的指引。我的两个腿暗自发力，挤压鸡鸡。然后有一种很舒服的感觉。

这个时候我还不知道怎么回事，开心的和好朋友分享，他们竟然都不知道。

然后我和我妈说了，我妈不叫我夹腿了。我问为什么，我妈也没说。因为真的太舒服了，所以我还是经常挤压。挤压。

后来有天挤出来了不知道什么东西，粘粘的。奇奇怪怪的味道。放在裆里面很难受，我就用两根手指头搓出来。

然后拇指和食指分开再合起来，重复弄，手里面像是胶水一样。我同桌以为是胶水，说给她点儿，她也想玩。我就分享给她了。

她想试试把自己的嘴巴粘住。我还没说话，她就呼上了。她说我买的垃圾货，一点都不沾。我说无良商家。我同桌是个小女生，因为从我鸡鸡哪里弄出来的，我也没好给她说🌚

之后她问我要怪怪的胶水，我说限定的，没有了。我怕她在呼嘴上。

多年以后我才知道，这种舒服的感觉是🦌只不过别人用手，我用腿。粘粘的液体是静夜🌚

我给你说个更详细的版本，彭德怀知道毛泽东是让他把太子带到朝鲜战场给太子镀金的，所以彭德怀要求毛岸英寸步不离他身边，彭德怀作为统帅总是安全的，也不会去到危险的地方，彭德怀是大老粗，他是这么表述的：我去茅房蹲坑，你没屎也得蹲我旁边，知道不？

毛岸英做蛋炒饭的时候，彭德怀很生气，其实离他并不远，叫他跟过来，他说今天这个蛋炒饭一定得吃上。

飞机看到冒烟就对着扔了个炸弹。毛岸英如果不死必然接老毛的班，子又生孙孙又有子，子子孙孙无穷匮也，也就没包子啥事儿了。

毛岸英被炸死这事儿毛泽东心里也清楚彭德怀已经尽力了，老天爷不让太子活着镀金回来，天命难违。蹲坑这个原话就是毛安插在彭德怀身边的另一个人表述给毛的。

彭德怀也知道自己不可能再和毛合作了，他于是就先下手了，但用人不当，犯了乔帮主同样的错，拉进来一起起事的人是毛的人，他本来是打算和苏联单独谈让苏联帮他联合干掉毛的。苏联也有此意，但被翻译出卖了。后来非常惨。刘少奇也同理，你干不掉对方必然被对方残忍的干死，这就是你死我活的政治斗争。

text:
提亲那天，女方父亲开口就是：“我们这边规矩，彩礼58万。”女朋友紧张地看着我。

我笑着说：“你女儿这么优秀，别说58万，158万我也愿意。”

她父亲脸上有了笑意，女朋友偷偷捏我的手。我话锋一转：“不过还有几件事想请教。”

她父亲端茶杯的手停了停：“你问。”

“第一，58万是给父母，还是带回小家庭？女方陪嫁多少？”

她父亲脸色一变：“你这是在谈条件？”
我说：“不是谈条件，是想把日子过明白。我愿意给彩礼是尊重你们，但不想婚后背着债过日子。”

我又问：“第二，婚房我买、装修我出，房产证写两个人名字，有没有意见？”
她母亲说应该的。

第三，孩子随谁姓？

女朋友说当然随你。

我看着她父亲：“我不是非要孩子随我姓，我是想知道，你们有没有把她当家里人。”

她父亲把茶杯一放：“你到底想说什么？”

我说：“58万可以给，但不能只要求男方，不要求女方。房子我出，贷款我还，婚后生活我扛，这些都没问题。

但女方也要拿出态度，不能一边要高额彩礼，一边把所有责任推给男方。”

她父亲火了：“这婚还想不想结？”我说：“想结，但想结得明白。”那天不欢而散。

第二天女朋友来找我：“我爸就是要个面子，你别太较真。”

我说：“面子不能当饭吃。今天我答应58万，婚后他还会提别的要求。”

她说那怎么办？我说：“彩礼可以给，但必须带回小家庭，陪嫁也要对等。”

她转告父母，她父亲起初不同意，说我没规矩。过了几天又主动找我，说可以商量。

最后谈定：彩礼按当地中等水平，女方陪嫁一辆车，钱带回小家庭，婚房写两个人名字。

有人说我太现实，结婚不该算这么清。但我知道，结婚不是一时热闹，是一辈子过日子。

彩礼可以给，但不能给得稀里糊涂；女方可以嫁，但不能嫁得毫无底气。靠谱的婚姻，不是男方一个人掏腰包，而是双方都愿意把日子往一处过。

text:
Sundar, Sundar, my friend, with respect, a benchmark table is not a comeback.

You invented the transformer. You had DeepMind, TPUs, YouTube, Search, Android, Gmail, and 3 billion Chrome users before anyone outside SF knew what an LLM was. 

You had every advantage a company could have.

And yet in late 2026, when a developer opens a terminal, it isn’t Gemini. When a founder builds an agent, it isn’t Gemini. When my non-tech friends say “I asked the AI,” they don’t mean Gemini.

That’s the scoreboard that matters, and Google is losing it.

Following Argon's release just two weeks ago, Carbon shows the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier, it ranks #1 on the recently updated v5.0 of @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index at 59. It also leads across key cybersecurity evaluations scoring 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for finding vulnerabilities, 54.8% on ExploitGym for exploitation, and 71.0% on CWE-bench for patching.

We’re seeing significant improvements in long-horizon tasks even compared to Argon, and we’ve strengthened frontier safeguards.

As we did with Argon, we’re going to roll it out gradually + responsibly. Some trusted cyber defenders will get access starting this week. We'll be expanding it to more partners through our Fairwind Program, ahead of wider availability soon, so hang tight!

text:
Compaction is a mistake.

When an agent's context fills up, tools like Codex and Claude Code compact it:
1. The model prefills the entire session again
2. It writes a summary of everything so far
3. A new session starts from that summary

I measured this on a real ~400k-token session with Opus 5.5:
→ 38 s and $1.99 when the prompt cache has expired
→ 29 s and $0.17 when it hasn't

And the summary is lossy. The exact error message, the file path, the one number you needed is often gone.

So I do something new for Mainplane

Context retrieval works the other way around. Mainplane keeps the full record of every session as a file. When the context fills up, a new session starts right away with one instruction: "You are continuing session X. Retrieve key context from it as you go."

The agent searches the old session and copies the exact lines it needs, when it needs them.

Same session, same model: 15 s and $0.10 to get back to work. It does not depend on a cache hit, and nothing is paraphrased.

This is the bitter lesson applied to agent memory. Don't hand-design what the model should remember. Give it the full record and good tools, and let it decide.

Mainplane is open source (MIT). Link in the first comment.

text:
Our company started an "optional wellness walk" every Wednesday at 6am.

The email went to 400 people.

The first Wednesday, I showed up. It was raining. It was me and one other man, an older guy in a grey tracksuit.

The second Wednesday, just us again.

We did that for a year. Every Wednesday. 6am. Forty minutes around the park.

We talked about everything. His divorce. My mum's surgery. The $2,000 I'd lost on a bad car.

I told him I was planning to quit. That nobody upstairs ever noticed people like me.

He never told me his last name. I never asked.

Then last month, there was an all-staff meeting. The CEO walked out onto the stage.

Grey tracksuit...

EMNLP开完了 随便说几个小观察

1. autoresearch用得太广了
我猜至少有四分之一的论文 一大部分是autoresearch做的 因为主图的同质化有点严重
没统计 纯感觉 以后只会更多

2. poster和oral的slides AI参与度更高
正文好歹还自己改改 slides基本一看就是AI做的

3. linear attention和transformer是在不同地方tradeoff
linear attention长文本省算力省显存 但长距离记忆差一点 要靠混几层full attention或者多训来补 最后算下来耗的资源差不多

4. DeepSeek Flash的粉丝比别的模型多太多了 虽然也听到提kimi glm的 问一问结果大家还是喜欢dpsk flash

5. workshop其实蛮好的 人少 可以直接走上前去提问
oral人太多了 反而没法好好聊

6. 主办方好像大部分都住会议酒店 看着像local chair
每天早上中午都在那儿碰头 不知道在聊什么

7. 会场的东西太难吃了 刷新了难吃的下限
social event那天的鸭腿是mvp

8. 布达佩斯很美
吃的有点像东北 大饼 牛肉汤 量大管饱

这位X上拥有~60K粉丝的老哥，三年前年薪50万美金，28年的工作经验，写过三本软件书籍的，在大厂工作过的，包括Adobe，Google搜索和 YouTube，最早的AI工程师，如今无家可归，只能住在车里!

我和未婚妻以及两只猫目前无家可归。我们找到了一套公寓，但我需要大约 2,000 美元（其中 1,400 美元用于支付第一个月的房租 + 搬家费用，我们需要租一辆 U-haul 把东西从仓库搬出来）。

眼下，2,000 美元就能结束我们的无家可归状态，让我们的生活重燃光明未来的希望。

他呼吁，我们需要全民基本收入（UBI）！

text:
男子在四川眉山一会所按摩时睡着，遭技师私自“手推”惊醒，警方立案调查。记者致电核实，遭会所店长还怒怼“关你屁事，你给我滚开！”。最近，四川成都的曾先生在网上发布视频，讲述了自己在四川省眉山市仁寿县出差时，在足浴店遇到的一件离谱糟心事。

曾先生表示，10月27日晚他喝了不少酒，28日凌晨一点多，他来到仁寿县的仁缦水疗足浴SPA会所做按摩。一开始按摩过程都挺正常，按着按着，迷迷糊糊的他就睡着了。睡着睡着，他突然感觉下体一阵冰凉，惊醒之后才发现，会所技师姜女士正在他下体上涂抹润滑油，对他进行“手推”。

曾先生当场制止了，技师姜女士的行为，立马质问对方为什么要这么做。姜女士表示“五百多元的套餐里面，本身就包含这项服务”。曾先生又气又惊，认为这家足浴店打着普通按摩的幌子，暗地里提供色情服务，属于典型的挂羊头卖狗肉。曾先生当场就拨打了110，民警赶到现场后进行了调查取证，目前，仁寿县公安局普宁派出所已立案，对技师姜女士以涉嫌卖淫开展调查。

曾先生还表示：10月28日上午和下午，普宁派出所的民警还把这家会所的店长和他约到派出所进行调解。会所方面提出，可以赔偿七八千元给曾先生了结此事，但曾先生没有同意，他向对方提出5~7万元的赔偿要求。

10月29日，都市现场记者联系上仁缦水疗足浴SPA会所的前台，工作人员告诉记者，涉事的技师姜女士已经不来店里上班了，至于人去了哪里，前台表示并不清楚。随后，记者拨通了这家会所店长的电话。刚表明采访来意，对方情绪就十分激动，直接怒怼：“关你屁事，你掺和这个事干嘛？你给我滚开！”

都市现场记者又联系了仁寿县公安局普宁派出所，值班工作人员表示他不熟悉案情，建议记者联系办案的张警官。记者尝试拨打张警官电话，但始终无法接通。记者还发现，截止目前，美团平台上还能搜到这家会所的团购套餐，有599元、149元等多款价位。

美团证照信息显示，这家仁缦水疗足浴SPA会所，注册名称其实是仁寿县普宁街道仁文时光印象休闲会所，经营者名叫辜建刚。

Real-world results are in: GPT-6.1 Terra (Max) by @OpenAI ranks #8 in Agent Arena across nearly 9K agentic sessions from our global community of users.

With +10.6% net improvement and a median cost per task of $0.62, it has reshaped the Pareto frontier! See its placement in the thread. Its median cost per task is:

- 43% lower than Gemini 4 Argon (High) at #7 ($1.09)
- 30% lower than GPT-6.1 Sol (Max) at #6 ($0.89)
- 88% lower than GPT-6 Astra (Max) at #5 ($5.16)

By signal, its strengths include:

- #7 in Steerability (+13.3%): whether the model can course-correct when you push back
- #3 in Bash Reliability (+13.2%): whether its commands succeed, excluding errors outside its control
- #9 in Praise vs Complaint (+16.8%): implicit sentiment in users’ reactions

Congrats again to the @OpenAI team on this release!

Compared to other models in the family, GPT-6.1 Terra (Max) is incredibly efficient:
- 81 pts below #4 GPT-6.1 Sol (1752 pts), at 75% lower median cost per task.
- Just 6 pts below #11 GPT-6 Sol (1677 pts), at 76% lower median cost per task

Congrats to the @OpenAI team on this release!

text:
每天一个反重力小技巧。

很多人觉得 Gemini 3.8 Flash 写代码不如 Claude 或 GPT 严谨，遇到复杂逻辑动不动就偷懒漏边界条件。
而Argon那少的可怜的配额根本不够用，最后明明手头捏着极其充裕的 3.8 额度，却只能拿来干点打杂的小活。

其实在反重力里直接裸奔写提示词，根本没把 Flash 的潜力榨出来。我现在日常跑任务，只要在任何提示词前加上
/teamwork /goal /plan 
这三个指令开关，直接就能把 3.8 Flash 逼出 Claude 和 GPT 级别的工程交付质量。

底层逻辑很简单，Flash 单次直出确实容易敷衍，但 Google 给 3.8 的额度非常足，根本不用心疼 Token。
用/teamwork 强行拉起多子智能体协同，
再用 /plan 锁死前置架构规划，
最后靠 /goal 钉死验收闭环不达目的绝不停机。
本质上就是拿 3.8 充裕得用不完的算力池，去暴力置换多轮反思和自我纠错的上下文深度，用算力数量硬砸出代码质量。

不过这套组合拳在实战里有两个极容易踩的暗坑。

千万别在开 /plan 的时候同时加上 /grill-me。
当需求比较模糊或者不知道怎么准确描述功能时，用 /grill-me 让模型反向拷问自己确实特别好使，

但 /plan 的底层机制会催着模型赶紧交出方案，两个指令混在一起打架，模型就会敷衍问你两句草草开工。

而且 /teamwork 内部本来就已经集成了需求对齐验证的环节，根本不需要叠床架屋。

真想用 /grill-me 深度对齐思路，就先单独跑完问答，下一步再开 /plan。

另一个细节是 /teamwork 在后台协调多个子智能体开会时，Token 吞吐量是极其惊人的。
正因为 3.8 Flash 额度管够，挂这三个开关才属于绝配；
如果换做平时觉得整套多智能体协同太重、或者想在单次任务里跑得更轻快一点，

每天一个反重力小技巧。

很多人觉得 Gemini 3.8 Flash 写代码不如 Claude 或 GPT 严谨，遇到复杂逻辑动不动就偷懒漏边界条件。
而Argon那少的可怜的配额根本不够用，最后明明手头捏着极其充裕的 3.8 额度，却只能拿来干点打杂的小活。

其实在反重力里直接裸奔写提示词，根本没把 Flash 的潜力榨出来。我现在日常跑任务，只要在任何提示词前加上
/teamwork /goal /plan 
这三个指令开关，直接就能把 3.8 Flash 逼出 Claude 和 GPT 级别的工程交付质量。

底层逻辑很简单，Flash 单次直出确实容易敷衍，但 Google 给 3.8 的额度非常足，根本不用心疼 Token。
用/teamwork 强行拉起多子智能体协同，
再用 /plan 锁死前置架构规划，
最后靠 /goal 钉死验收闭环不达目的绝不停机。
本质上就是拿 3.8 充裕得用不完的算力池，去暴力置换多轮反思和自我纠错的上下文深度，用算力数量硬砸出代码质量。

不过这套组合拳在实战里有两个极容易踩的暗坑。

千万别在开 /plan 的时候同时加上 /grill-me。
当需求比较模糊或者不知道怎么准确描述功能时，用 /grill-me 让模型反向拷问自己确实特别好使，

但 /plan 的底层机制会催着模型赶紧交出方案，两个指令混在一起打架，模型就会敷衍问你两句草草开工。

而且 /teamwork 内部本来就已经集成了需求对齐验证的环节，根本不需要叠床架屋。

真想用 /grill-me 深度对齐思路，就先单独跑完问答，下一步再开 /plan。

另一个细节是 /teamwork 在后台协调多个子智能体开会时，Token 吞吐量是极其惊人的。
正因为 3.8 Flash 额度管够，挂这三个开关才属于绝配；

text:
Sam Altman近期参加播客节目，有很多值得分享的信息。

Navier-Stokes 的代价：OpenAI 在攻克 Navier-Stokes 这一千禧数学难题时，单次证明的算力成本约为 1,000万美元 (17:54-18:08)

未发表的宝库：Sam Altman 透露，OpenAI 内部已经完成了比已公开的成果（如数学证明）多的多、更深层的科学发现，只是尚未全部发布 (18:26-18:35)。

平衡发展与人文关怀：Altman 明确表示，尽管世界有权获取基础科学发现，但他对数学家及科学家因AI自动化研究而产生的失落感抱有同情。他正在思考如何既能造福人类，又对这些推动科学进步的群体保持敏感与尊重 (18:43-20:30)。

拒绝单一超级智能：Altman 明确表示，比起一个IQ达到一万亿的“单一超级AI”，他更倾向于让万亿个“稍微超人”的 AI 加入人类社会，通过竞争与制衡维持社会稳定 (24:14-24:27)。

最后这个观点听起来美好，实际意味着有钱人就有超级超级智能，普通人只能有稍微高级的智能，我看人类是不会好了。

播客视频：https://t.co/jRuuk01zbN

Here's my plan for how OpenAI could make a crazy comeback:

- Pretty obvious, but release Astra 6.1. I'm sure it's ready, or almost ready. They HAVE to release it, make it better than Opus 5.5, and make it at least 50% cheaper/more efficient so $200 Pro users don't feel the nerfs as much.
- Work on improving Dots. I think they're still pretty far behind Grok Bot, and just making something very similar to it would be the best move.
- Revert the decision to nerf $200 Pro users' limits by 50%. This is CRAZY, and I think most paying Pro users are on the $200 tier, so a lot of people will be mad about it.
- Make the Codex app good again. Personally, I think the Codex app's prime was around GPT-5.5's release. It's gotten more features since then, sure, but it's also become sloppier and more bloated.
- Fix their uptime and backend issues. A lot of requests end in errors, on both ChatGPT and Codex. This is honestly unacceptable, and they should focus on fixing it as much as they can.

Giving out resets every day won't fix these issues, and they can't keep doing that forever. I know these are basically the most well-known, common issues, but I hope someone sees this and actually fixes at least one of them.

text:
We used to talk about a "pit of success".

Humans would be dragged towards writing the right code by well-designed API's, a good test suite, sensible lint rules.

You couldn't make the pit too steep, otherwise the humans would get annoyed. There was a social contract.

Feels like what we need now is a black hole of success. An inescapable event horizon agents cannot cross.

Agents don't feel annoyed, so you can crank up the pressure to infinity. There is no social contract to break.

In other words, increase the forces on agents to the maximum. Make great code inevitable.

Starting today you can replicate any video from TikTok and make it your own on https://t.co/CFAg7ozq3b.

This is NOT just one of those cheap AI replication tools that swaps out the person in the video and keeps everything else the same.

Here's how this works:

1) You select the videos you want to replicate and the AI avatars you want to do this with

2) You input what you want to be different about your version of the video, the duration, and whether you want us to automatically promote your product

3) We analyze the original video, scene by scene, to understand precisely what's happening

4) We take what you prompted to be different, the workspace media files you uploaded, and your business information

5) We translate all of that into a written creative concept for your new video (we do not reference the original video pixels past this stage)

6) The creative concept then goes through our video generation pipeline where we carefully produce the video scene by scene

7) Our editing agent runs over the video and polishes it

8) You get your video back ready to post to TikTok & Instagram through our iPhone farm, in minutes

We automatically incorporate demos of your product into the video, like screen recordings of your app, if that was the intent of the original video you referenced & the instructions you gave us.

I'm telling you guys nothing like this exists and you need to go try it for yourself because it's actual magic.

Available on https://t.co/CFAg7ozq3b today.

CALIFORNIA, HOW TO LOWER TAXES AND IMPROVE OVERSIGHT

What will Californians be voting on this November?

In this episode of Dr. Daniel Show, I break down several California ballot propositions covering state reserves, campaign financing, recall procedures, housing, taxes and public spending.

Here are the measures discussed:

- **Proposition 2:** Changes to the constitutional rules governing state reserves.
- **Proposition 4:** Public funding programs for political campaigns.
- **Proposition 5:** Changes to the process for replacing state officials removed through a recall.
- **Proposition 37:** A proposed bond-funded loan program for certain buyers of newly built homes.
- **Proposition 41:** Audits of programs financed by certain special taxes and restrictions involving some new taxes.
- **Proposition 42:** Restrictions on certain state taxes based solely on ownership of personal assets.
- **Proposition 43:** A two-thirds vote requirement for certain local special tax increases or extensions.
- **Proposition 44:** A requirement for certain nonprofit community health centers to spend at least 90% of revenue on services related to their mission.

Throughout the discussion, I examine questions about government spending, public accountability, housing supply, taxation and how ballot measures could affect state and local policies.

My goal is to explain the proposals and encourage viewers to look beyond their titles by examining what each measure would change, how it would be funded and who would oversee the money.

Watch the full discussion and learn more about the issues shaping California’s policy debate.

Subscribe to Dr. Daniel Show on YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok for more discussions on current events and public policy.

text:
Today we're launching @snaptrude Agent, the most advanced agent for building design.

It does real design work with you, from a site to a construction-ready LOD 400 model with structure, MEP and drawings. Then can go back to your existing software with your families intact.

About a year ago we bet the company on AI. Honestly the insight came from software engineering. It wasn't long ago that autocomplete felt like a big deal, and now engineers direct agents that write a lot of the code. I think the same shift is coming to how we design buildings, and it's already started.

Most designers I meet aren't short on skill, they're short on time. Take the call every design team dreads, the client cuts the budget by 30%. Today that's a bad month for everyone. With the agent you're the director. You decide where the cost comes out, and it updates the layout, coordinates the structure and MEP, and redoes the drawings. So when design exploration gets this cheap, we go from 3 options to 300, and more options means better buildings.

Since August our users have gone through more than 140 billion tokens, and firms like Jacobs, Studio+, Kajima, VMDO, Dekker and hundreds of others use Snaptrude today. In our early access, more than 2,000 designers have run over 25,000 tasks through the agent since September.

We also built a benchmark for this, AECBench, because in AEC an almost correct answer is still wrong. It gives AI the same brief an architect would get, has its design in a real BIM model, and scores the result against the brief and against how architects review design. We're publishing the first results today, link below.

Thank you @prashanthp at @Accel and Shub and the team at @foundamental for backing us when this was still a bet, and the Snaptrude team, who built every bit of this. Really proud of you all.

Thanks to our investors, @scottbelsky, @andreasklinger, @thilokonzok, @immad, @CindyXBi, @DanilaVladi, @jmwass, rahulchaudhary, @adamecourt,  Zach Ginsburg, Alex duff, Paul grossinger, really appreciate all the help along the way.

text:
小鹏前两天“拒绝登味”的发布会，本来想露脸，结果把屁股露出来了。
在全球民族主义情绪日趋高涨的今天，在纯粹国内发布会用英文彰显自己的“高端”，结果适得其反。不但官媒暗戳戳点名了，买家也不认。
这我想起了2010年左右的一个互联网流行笑话：“过年了，北上广的Mary、Vivian和David陆续回老家，变成了翠花、大妮和二狗子…”
到什么地方说什么话，这个是企业的一个最基本认知。
在这方面，可以举一个比较过分但在中文特定圈子非常常见的例子：“Mary啊，今天这个launch event，我们的brand positioning一定要足够premium，整个presentation必须让消费者feel到一种very high-end的感觉。”
这叫专业么？这叫懒！
我不是讨厌中英文混用，对于一个长期生活在英语为日常用语环境的人来说，一些关键术语一时找不到合适的对应中文，用一下毫无问题，但这种事先充分准备的讲稿，无论专业术语还是人名，这么弄就完全没必要了。在国内市场开发布会，以中文姓名示人，真的不丢人。

Dear @enhanced_games community,

Please note that the $ENHA reverse stock split became effective today. 

Every 10 shares have been consolidated into 1.

Nothing else has changed. Economically, a reverse stock split is a non-event: it does not change the company’s fundamentals, market capitalization, or underlying value.

However, the reverse split has one important potential upside: it may make $ENHA more accessible to a broader range of investors.

Many brokers and banks impose restrictions on trading stocks priced below approximately $3. Several retail investors have reached out to me here on X over the last months, explaining that buying $ENHA had become quite a hassle for them for this very reason.

Additionally, some mutual funds face investment restrictions that prevent them from buying stocks trading below certain price thresholds, often in the $3–5 range, although these vary by fund.

We are seeing considerable inbound interest in $ENHA by both retail and institutional investors. Against this backdrop, I believe the reverse split could help broaden our investor base and make the stock more accessible.

A few important details:

Ticker: Unchanged - $ENHA
New CUSIP: 29333R206
New total shares outstanding: 13,681,637
